evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'I need ten to fifteen minutes of your time. So is this a good time to talk about your move?' — time-boxed ask is present, but does not frame the value of 'a quote you can depend on' and moves forward without clearly securing a yes, just proceeding on the customer's initial 'Yes ma'am' to the first greeting.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Jared), moving day (October 13th), pickup and dropoff cities (San Antonio to San Antonio), square footage (750 sq ft apartment), bedrooms (1 to 3) — all four core items covered.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after detailed probing: 'Before I dispose with you the pricing and the estimate, do you have any concerns about the moving process.' Customer responds 'No, not right now.' — agenda came after logistics questions, not before.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment and house), floor/stories (6th floor, 2-story house), rooms (1 bed apartment, 3 bed house), walking distance (20–30 ft to elevator, 25 yards on floor), additional rooms (none stated), special considerations (couch with recliners, queen mattress, elevator reserved), additional stops (none) — substantially complete.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep: 'Normally for a one bedroom apartment we see fifteen to 25 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?' Customer confirms range is fair.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides $672–$864 range anchored to 'usually for a one bedroom apartment we finish it... at three and a half hours but in your case... 6th floor with reserved elevator... Going to a two story house. I estimate at the move to finish in three and a half to four and a half hours' — both typical range and personalization present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses hourly rate ($192/hour for two movers), what's included (gas, truck, taxes, insurance, wraps, pads, tools), no hidden fees (no credit card, stereo, transportation fees), and 2.5-hour minimum with 15-minute increments prorated — comprehensive fee and commitment framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moves directly from pricing into rate-lock/deposit offer without asking 'Does that feel fair?' or pausing for customer reaction.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep asks 'So with that, would you like to be on the schedule for October 13th?' — a direct ask, but immediately followed by customer objection (waiting for other quotes) and rep responds by offering an out: 'you're free to call back this number' and 'I'll just send you an email... you could just reply to that email or give us a call.' The ask itself is plain, but the follow-up explicitly provides easy outs without attempting to close.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Never mentioned. No reference to any on-time discount guarantee.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Never mentioned. No reference to No Worries Damage Coverage or $2,000 coverage.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep states 'we can secure your truck for October 13th, we do not require any deposit so no risk and securing your spot' — rate/spot security and no-deposit framing present.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date confirmed (October 13th), pickup address confirmed (847 E Ashley, Tobin Hill, San Antonio 78212), dropoff address confirmed (2814 Dull Tour, San Antonio 78230), but no phone number re-confirmed, no arrival window time discussed, no crew size confirmed, no notes left for crew about concerns — partial confirmation only.

top_strength: Jeline gathered comprehensive logistics details methodically (floor, parking, walking distances, special items, appliances, both addresses) and anchored the estimate to the customer's specific move complexity, showing discipline in probing.
coaching_note: Section 5 (Two Promises) was completely skipped — the On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage are core commitments that must be delivered before asking for the business; Section 6 (final concerns check) was also skipped, and Section 4 is missing the 'Does that feel fair?' pause that creates space for real objection handling.
